cardData.t62: It might not quite be the "real thing", but I'm glad you're here playing with us at OpenZoo all the same. To the future!
cardData.t30: {Star}**:** {I:Open a booster pack from the {BI:Cryptid Nation} block and reveal all opened Pages to all Casters. Choose one of those Pages and place it into your Chapter. When the chosen Page enters a Discard Zone it's removed from the game. Remove the chosen Page from your Spellbook at the end of this game.}
